question: Show Head and Neck trials with at least 2 prior lines of therapy that used combination treatment.

gemini.answer: This SQL query retrieves clinical trials related to Head and Neck cancer where the patients had at least two prior lines of therapy and received combination treatment.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\" FROM public.\"clinical_trials\" WHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Head and Neck%' AND \"lines_of_treatment\" ILIKE '%2L+%' AND \"therapy_type\" = 'Combination therapy'",
  "answer": "This SQL query retrieves clinical trials related to Head and Neck cancer where the patients had at least two prior lines of therapy and received combination treatment.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
